originalTitle: Lamborghini’s flagship Revuelto levels up with SV trim

content: A lot of automakers talk about wanting to minimize or eliminate driver distractions so as to make the experience of driving more rewarding and safer overall. Lamborghini has a different strategy; it wants the driver to become one with their vehicle. This helps explain the storied super car maker’s tagline for the new Revuelto SV: the quantum of driving. “For us, quantum of driving is the moment when you get into the car, you start driving the car, and the car and you become one piece,” said Alessandro Farmeschi, product line director for the Revuelto, the Italian brand’s top V12 powered model. “And you start just thinking about your drive, feeling the adrenaline of the acceleration, braking, the G-forces, you know. You feel everything and you basically forget about the rest because you are so concentrated and you enjoy so much this experience.” Be the car! What better way to be less bothered by all of modern life’s distraction? I can’t speak from experience, having not driven the Revuelto yet, but standing next to the sharklike SV version, you can certainly begin to understand where Farmeschi and his colleagues are coming from. Be the car? Sure, I’ll be this car. And I’ll eat all others on the road for breakfast. SV stands for Superveloce or “superfast,” which dates back to the iconic 1971 Miura SV. Lamborghini has also used the designation on higher-performance versions of the Diablo, Murciélago, and Aventador — and now the Revuelto, it’s flagship V12 supercar. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8265.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8266.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8268.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8269.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8273.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] It’s a high-performance evolution of an already very fast, very high performing vehicle, which begs the question: How much is too much? The Revuelto SV’s hybrid-electric powertrain still features a 6.5-liter naturally aspirated V12 and three electric motors, which can put out 1,065cv (around 1,050 hp), or around a 50 hp boost over the standard Revuelto. The additional capability is supported by a revised battery package that retains the same basic shape and geometry but increases energy capacity by 7.3kWh and provides higher power output. The battery improvements are intended not simply to produce a higher peak figure but to make the car’s performance more consistent during hard driving. Lamborghini wanted the SV to deliver a flatter and more consistent level of performance throughout a lap rather than experiencing larger variations in output, Farmeschi explained. The transmission shifting time has also been reduced by 30 percent for a more responsive and effective acceleration. Carbon fiber is used extensively throughout the vehicle to shave crucial kilograms. The front bumper is completely new, while the rear wing, door panels, and new racing seats also use carbon fiber as part of the effort to slim down and improve performance. The result? The Revuelto SV posts a power-to-weight ratio of 1.66 kg/CV, as compared to 1.75kg/CV for the standard Revuelto. Every milligram matters. Downforce has been increased by 80 percent, thanks to the new front bumper and rear wing, which Farmeschi explained incorporates two wing designs into one. The front-end changes alone provide a 100 percent increase in front downforce compared with the standard Revuelto, which gives the car greater stability as it enters corners and begins turning, effectively helping to “glue” the front of the car to the track. This enables a 0–62mph acceleration in just 2.4 seconds — on par with the limited-edition Fenomeno, which Lamborghini previously described as its “fastest” in production. (I guess the Fenomeno will have to share that distinction now.) [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8271.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8278.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8288.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8286.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8290.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] But for Farmeschi, it’s not just about track performance metrics — it’s also about emotion. “Because emotion is driving the car, it’s being so fast… enjoying the car, going beyond even your limits because the car also helps you to manage the performance,” he said. Of course, enhanced acceleration and performance also demands enhanced braking. The Revuelto SV features a new CCM-R Plus braking system, as compared to the carbon-ceramic brakes used on the standard Revuelto. The discs are thicker and larger in diameter, with radial holes extending along the radius to improve cooling. The result is a braking system capable of handling greater levels of stress while allowing the driver to brake harder and later. Speaking of driving dynamics, Lamborghini is introducing a new Pilota mode, derived from its GT racing program. The driver can activate Pilota mode using the helmet icon on the steering wheel and then choose one of five levels using the rotary controls. These settings alter how sensitive the car is to its stability systems. The vehicle incorporates ABS and stability-control systems as well as a six-dimensional sensor located in the center tunnel, which measures vertical, lateral, and longitudinal acceleration as well as roll, pitch, and other vehicle movements.
chineseTitle: 兰博基尼旗舰 Revuelto 升级 SV 内饰
chineseSummary: 许多汽车制造商都表示希望最大限度地减少或消除驾驶员的干扰，从而使驾驶体验更有价值、更安全。兰博基尼有不同的策略；它希望驾驶员与车辆合而为一。这有助于解释这家传奇超级汽车制造商对新款 Revuelto SV 的口号：[...]
chineseContent: 许多汽车制造商都表示希望最大限度地减少或消除驾驶员的干扰，从而使驾驶体验更有价值、更安全。兰博基尼有不同的策略；它希望驾驶员与车辆合而为一。这有助于解释这家传奇超级汽车制造商的新款 Revuelto SV 的口号：驾驶的量子。 “对我们来说，驾驶的时间是当你进入汽车，开始驾驶汽车，汽车和你成为一体的那一刻，”意大利品牌顶级 V12 动力车型 Revuelto 的产品线总监 Alessandro Farmeschi 说道。 “你开始只考虑你的驾驶，感受加速、制动和重力的肾上腺素，你知道。你感觉到一切，基本上忘记了其余的，因为你是如此专注，你非常享受这种体验。”成为汽车！还有什么更好的方法可以减少现代生活中的各种干扰呢？我无法凭经验来说话，因为我还没有驾驶过 Revuelto，但站在鲨鱼般的 SV 版本旁边，你肯定可以开始理解 Farmeschi 和他的同事们来自哪里。是车吗？当然，我会是这辆车。我会吃掉路上所有其他人的早餐。 SV 代表 Superveloce 或“超快”，其历史可以追溯到 1971 年标志性的 Miura SV。兰博基尼还在 Diablo、Murciélago 和 Aventador 的高性能版本上使用了该名称，现在又在旗舰 V12 超级跑车 Revuelto 上使用了该名称。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8265.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/0X7B8266.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.th
